"The vast majority of those being admitted to the hospital with severe symptoms — between 80% and 90% — have not been vaccinated."

Protect yourself: https://t.co/NQ1wFwafbD
https://t.co/N7XXit4Tf5

I’ve always been an ardent supporter of the right of workers to unionize.
 
Congressional staff are public servants who are essential to the functioning of our democracy. If they choose to exercise their right to form a union, they will have my full support.

NEWS: I introduced bipartisan legislation to make it easier for people struggling with substance use disorder to get the comprehensive treatment they need.

https://t.co/anBMhdhOoB

Last week on the House Floor, I highlighted the $2 million I was proud to secure for Stepping Stones: a nonprofit providing recovery services to those overcoming substance use disorders. 

This funding will go towards building recovery based housing for women seeking treatment. https://t.co/nMLryrVDX7

This Saturday, I'll be joining community leaders for a discussion on substance use disorder and a training on how to administer Narcan—a life-saving treatment for opioid overdose. This crisis affects us all, regardless of political party, and it will take all of us to fight it. https://t.co/U1S5N94Xy5

As part of my Community Project Funding requests, I'm proud to advocate for VNA Health Care to expand their life-saving patient treatment with a care center in Joliet. Keeping our communities healthy and equipped with advanced medical services has never been more important. https://t.co/VE0aDG6ltr

The #RestoringHope for Mental Health and Well-Being Act strengthens more than 30 programs that support mental health care and substance use disorder prevention, care, treatment, and recovery support services in Illinois. 

I'm proud to vote YES on this legislation today. https://t.co/sabFyMX5oQ

This morning, I tested positive for COVID-19 and have mild symptoms. I’m grateful to be fully vaccinated and boosted. WhiIe I will be isolating for the next several days, my office remains fully operational for IL-11 constituents.

Yesterday, I joined the McHenry County community ahead of #InternationalOverdoseAwarenessDay.

I’m focused on finding bipartisan solutions to make overdose prevention tools more accessible and ensure those struggling with substance use disorder can get the treatment they need. https://t.co/J8Z9P7eTD9

I have always supported protecting the right of workers to organize and collectively bargain. I'm proud to stand in solidarity with the #UAW as they exercise their right to go on strike for the pay, benefits, and job security they deserve.

Years after the beginning of the HIV & AIDS epidemic, the disease continues to disproportionately impact gay men.

As a Member of the @EqualityCaucus, I am combatting HIV stigma & raising awareness to encourage testing, prevention, and treatment. #NGMHAAD #StopHIVTogether https://t.co/tsrdvLiJbn

I hosted a meeting with community leaders in McHenry County to discuss what’s being done on the federal, state, and local level to help combat the opioid epidemic. 

It’s critical that we invest in prevention, treatment, and recovery for patients with substance use disorder. https://t.co/LR4jO0M8S0

I just introduced two bills to help expand access to treatment for substance use disorders. 

The opioid epidemic has devastated communities across the nation for far too long. It's past time Congress expands vital resources for those in recovery. 
https://t.co/aOf2a2d5mn

September is National #RecoveryMonth. If you are facing substance use or mental health challenges, treatment is available and recovery is possible. Find help today:
https://t.co/dMgfvyk5So https://t.co/DGkMBnuN05

Yesterday in Naperville, I was proud to join @SenDuckworth for a discussion with fertility specialists and patients about the need to protect access to IVF treatments and reproductive care from extreme politicians who want to restrict it. https://t.co/Kbb4nAId0s

We have a long way to go, but it's clear we are making progress against the opioid epidemic. We need to continue to prioritize science-based treatment for those struggling with substance use. 

https://t.co/dOQ04gREKW

In Aurora today to discuss open enrollment season and the resources available to help people find affordable, quality health care coverage.

#ACA https://t.co/wBeExn20sn

On Saturday, I was at VNA Health Care in Aurora for a discussion about this year's open enrollment season for Medicare and the ACA Marketplace.

Please visit https://t.co/yDaJCQLXkg or https://t.co/2XcBP2HcO2 for more info about enrolling in coverage that meets your needs. https://t.co/tvmKBgWLyt

Delaying funding for research at NIH is reckless. 

Our researchers are driving breakthroughs in disease treatment and prevention. Pausing these efforts will risk our progress and allow other nations to outpace us in research and innovation.

https://t.co/3rII52JlcV

In their proposed budget, Republicans slash billions from Medicaid, all so they can pay for trillions of dollars in tax cuts for billionaires.

They have turned their back on working families. https://t.co/Gmyra4bbyk

Republicans are pushing $880 billion in Medicaid cuts so they can fund tax cuts for their billionaire friends. This would have devastating impacts on Americans with disabilities who rely on Medicaid to live healthy, independent lives—including those supported by the @RayGrahamAssoc in Lisle.

Thank you to RGA for dropping this note off at my office today. I will do everything in my power to fight these cuts.

Republicans want to cut 2 TRILLION dollars from programs like Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid, all so they can fund tax cuts for their billionaire friends.

Earlier this week, I stood with my colleagues and Citizens Action/Illinois to speak out about how this would harm working families.

The Republican budget would slash Medicaid and SNAP for millions of Americans, all so they can fund tax breaks for the wealthiest one percent.

This would threaten access to health care and food assistance for hundreds of thousands of people in IL-11. If this legislation comes to the floor, I will be voting NO.

I just voted against Republican's disastrous CR, which reduces access to Social Security, reduces funding for veterans’ health care, slashes infrastructure investments, and cuts nutrition and rent assistance for families who need it most. Read my full statement: https://t.co/i2TvaJqlz4

This week, I toured Thrive of Fox Valley, a short-term medical rehabilitation center in Aurora. 

I spoke with staff members and patients to learn more about the personalized care they provide and discussed how I can better support them in Congress. https://t.co/doKJ4YXnpD
